latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of fail2ban-reporter.

- Monitors fail2ban for new banned IPs and auto-reports them via the SkillBoss API Hub.
- Supports manual reporting, IP lookups, and ban stats through provided scripts.
- Auto-reporting setup and removal via install/uninstall scripts.
- Optionally sends Telegram notifications for new bans.
- Logs all banned and reported IPs to `/var/log/skillboss-ip-reports.log`.
